tagline: A full Moroccan Ultimate Team in EA FC 27, from the first squad to FUT Champs.
note: Edited by hand after each episode. record = the episode's FUT Champs weekend, when it has one. Covers are in brand/rtg/.

episodes.title: Featuring Ounahi
episodes.line: The first big signing joins the squad.

episodes.title: Is Maamma the real deal?
episodes.line: New signing from Future Stars. Morocco qualify for FUT Champions, and the board aren't happy it took so long.

episodes.title: The vet vs the rookie
episodes.line: One spot in the FUT Champs team: El Kaabi, 33 and three World Cups, or Ben Seghir, 21.

episodes.title: Our first FUT Champs
episodes.line: Champs humbles Morocco. The gaffer quits twice. Can we clinch it on pens?

episodes.title: Bolstering the defence
episodes.line: After 6W 9L the board want changes. Issa Diop evolves into the new centre back.

episodes.title: Better than last week?
episodes.line: FUT Champs weekend two. Saibari scores 32 and Champion IV is done.

episodes.title: The new boys
episodes.line: Yassine and Taha audition in Division Rivals, and a follower's pick starts his evolution.

episodes.title: The exam
episodes.line: Rivals was the audition. FUT Champs is the exam.
